1 Run Wifi Album in your iOS devices, such as your iPhone and iPad, the screen display should show "Direct your computer's web browser to: http://xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx:8080", this mean you
have a wifi network and run ok.

2 Switch to "Devices tab", you will see the other device, if nothing found, press the refresh button on the right and waiting.

3 Click device in "Devices" tab to view the shared files, you can download them in detail page.
